blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima on Monday honored late former Northern Samar Rep. Raul Daza by recalling his “reassuring presence” when she was imprisoned, noting how the latter was once subject of persecution. De Lima made these remarks during the necrological service of the House of Representatives for Daza, who once served at the lower chamber for seven terms between 1969 and 2019 and was a member of the Liberal Party for 61 years. Daza passed away at the age of 91 last October 12. READ: Ex-Northern Samar solon Raul Daza dead at 91, family confirms De […]...
